features.name: Instructional Text in Prompt Dialog
features.description: New capability to provide concise instructions to help users in the prompt dialog by updating the instructional text property on fields in your prompt area. These instructions are displayed as instructional text to help users understand what input is expected.
caveats: Not meant to be used as example prompts, this is general instruction

features.name: Prompt Guides
features.description: New feature that allows developers to provide prompt templates to help users understand the range of prompts they can create. Accessed through a book icon on the prompt dialog, prompts guides are implemented as a new area in actions on a prompt dialog page type.
caveats: Can be grouped if more than one prompt guide exists

features.name: Copilot Actions on Lists and Dialogs
features.description: New capability to display copilot actions on lists, list parts, worksheets and standard dialogs to draw attention and launch prompt dialogs. These actions are displayed at the bottom of the page and in the menu.

features.name: Token Counting
features.description: Functionality that allows developers to count the number of tokens that will be used by input before sending a request to Azure OpenAI. Tokens are the units the model uses instead of words.
caveats: Only counts input tokens, not output
Does not currently include system meta prompt but that is coming

features.name: Token Counting Methods in AOI Token Code Unit
features.description: New methods in the AOI token code unit for counting tokens per model: get GPT 3.5 token count, get GPT 4 token count, get other token count, and DG token count. These methods are version agnostic across model variants.
caveats: Version agnostic across model variants like GPT-4 January vs June
Does not currently include system meta prompt

features.name: Function Calling
features.description: Feature that allows developers to describe functions to the assistant model and have it return the functions that should be called along with appropriate arguments. This extracts key information from natural language for use as function arguments.

features.name: Function Calling in Copilot
features.description: Capability to add tools and functions to chat messages that call get weather copilot functions and process responses from Azure OpenAI.
caveats: Functions should not be hardcoded as text but retrieved from isolated storage or Azure Key Vault
Descriptions are IP and must be protected

features.name: Function Calling Tool Choice
features.description: AL development feature that allows setting tool choice to instruct the model to always run a specific function. Provides control over which function the model will execute.

features.name: Tool Choice Auto Mode
features.description: Default tool choice setting where response can be either a function call or regular chat response, requiring error handling for cases where function is expected but not returned.
caveats: Requires error handling since response may not be a function call

features.name: Tool Choice Specific Function Mode
features.description: Mode where tool choice is set to a specific function name, guaranteeing the model will always call that function but requiring validation of arguments.
caveats: Requires argument validation when user input is unrelated to the function

features.name: Model Version Management
features.description: System to keep two versions of each AI model available - latest (stable released) and preview (new upcoming) - allowing developers to test before production updates.
caveats: Different model versions may perform differently requiring feature testing

features.name: Version Agnostic Model Strings
features.description: Implementation approach using version-agnostic strings like turbo-latest that map to specific Azure OpenAI versions, enabling smooth model version transitions.

features.name: Managed and Shared AI Resources
features.description: Service that provides managed AI infrastructure for first-party and third-party copilot features, eliminating the need for partners to bring their own Azure OpenAI accounts.
features.status_evidence_quote: private preview will happen pretty soon after the business centrer launch event
caveats: Requires new responsible AI compliance process
Private preview starting April-May 2024
Public preview planned for 2025
General availability pending preview feedback

features.name: AI Credit Resource Governance
features.description: Single unified currency called AI credit that converts to various consumption units like GPT tokens or machine learning predictions, used to track and control AI resource usage.
caveats: Not yet finalized
To be modeled through simulated enforcement in preview

features.name: Operational Limits for Fair Use
features.description: Resource governance mechanism using operational limits to ensure fair AI credit consumption among users, environments and customers by controlling consumption speed.
caveats: Still being modeled and finalized through preview

features.name: AI Quota Entitlements
features.description: Quota system with base capacity and accrued capacity per user license, allowing customers to budget AI consumption and purchase incremental capacity for excess usage.
caveats: To be modeled through simulated enforcement
Incremental capacity purchase model still being finalized

features.name: Capacity-based resource governance and pricing
features.description: Modeling and finalizing capacity-based resource governance and pricing through simulated limit and quota enforcement for managed and shared AI resources.
features.status_evidence_quote: capacity based resource governance and pricing will be modeled and finalized through simulated limit and quota enforcement in private or public preview
caveats: Private preview roadmap estimated for 24.0 in April or 24.1 in May
Public preview planned for 25x version
GA timeline still to be determined pending preview feedback

features.name: Responsible AI process for non-OpenAI accounts
features.description: New process to satisfy responsible AI requirements when not using your own OpenAI accounts, to be introduced in public preview.
caveats: Timeline: next release around 25x version

features.name: Limit and quota publishing and enforcement
features.description: Public preview will introduce proper limits to be published and enforced, with quotas published but not enforced initially. GA will enforce both limits and quotas.
features.status_evidence_quote: in public preview we will also make sure that the proper limit will be published and enforced while the proper quota might also be
caveats: GA timeline: TBD depending on preview feedback

features.name: Developer toolkit for Copilot in Business Central
features.description: Toolkit providing AL code capabilities to extend Copilot, addressing developer questions on feature support, data access, and model selection.
caveats: Does not support all latest Azure OpenAI features
Only preview specifications not supported in toolkit

features.name: Azure OpenAI data access control
features.description: Commitment that Azure OpenAI has no access to Business Central data, models do not learn from data, and users retain full control.
caveats: Data must fit within prompt size limits if passed to model
User permissions apply to copilot features

features.name: Data source capability for Azure OpenAI
features.description: Optional capability to pass data to Azure OpenAI using data sources, available for partner feedback and prioritization.
caveats: Implementation in AL toolkit not yet decided, awaiting partner input

features.name: GPT-3.5 Turbo model recommendation
features.description: Recommended to use GPT-3.5 Turbo when it meets scenario needs, as it is faster and cheaper, and covers most scenarios well.
caveats: GPT-4 or GPT-4 Turbo recommended for complex scenarios or high token consumption

features.name: AL toolkit open source on GitHub
features.description: The AL part of the copilot toolkit is open source and available in the aka.ms/bc-apps repository on GitHub, allowing community contributions.

features.name: Data privacy and AI model training
features.description: Commitment that AI models are not trained on customer data and do not learn from it, with compliance reviews more strict than legal requirements.
